summary: Regression pass for TaxQuest rebrand + Bearer-token fallback fix. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (21 from iteration_1 + 5 NEW Bearer-fallback tests validating that /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register return access_token in the JSON body, /api/auth/me works with only an Authorization: Bearer header and no cookies, and /api/quiz/submit works with only Bearer and correctly increments total_score/best_streak/achievements). Frontend: primary user regression 'login → clear cookies → reload → still authenticated' PASSES — after page.context.clear_cookies() and reload the user stays on /dashboard and /api/auth/me returns 200 via Bearer token from localStorage['taxquest_token'] (verified via in-page fetch). App fully rebranded: browser title 'TaxQuest — Learn taxes, one quiz at a time', sidebar shows 'TaxQuest' + 'LEARN · PLAY · WIN', chatbot header 'TaxQuest AI', no 'TaxMaster' text visible anywhere on Login or Dashboard body (only allowed reference is the admin email admin@taxmaster.pro which is expected). All flows verified: Register with 'Getting there' → Dashboard persona banner shows 'GETTING THERE', Indian Quiz answer shows feedback + Next progresses to Q 2, World Explorer renders 48 cards and search 'India' narrows to 1, Save Smart India estimator with income 1200000 + 80C 150000 + 80D 25000 produces result with 'saved' figure, Leaderboard shows 6 ranked rows with medals, Admin Panel lists 48 rows and edit → save persists to backend (verified by GET /api/countries), Chatbot streams Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply in ~6s using ONLY the Bearer token (after cookies cleared).

ui_bugs.issue: Notes textarea has no data-testid — tests must fall back to 'textarea' selector. Not blocking but reduces testability.

edit-<encoded-key> and delete-<encoded-key> testids OK, but from iteration_1 residual note: earlier the report flagged region-based collisions — verified fixed in current code (now uses encodeURIComponent(c.key)).

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: /api/auth/refresh sets access_token cookie but does not also return access_token in body — for full Bearer parity, refresh should optionally return the new token so SPA can update localStorage when the older 7-day token expires. Not blocking right now because ACCESS_MINUTES = 7 days.

server.py logout depends on current_user which fails 401 if user has neither cookie nor Bearer — a logged-out client that already lost its token cannot call /logout to clear a stray cookie. Consider making /logout tolerate anonymous callers (200 OK + clear cookies unconditionally).
AdminPanel edit textarea lacks data-testid (easy add).

AuthContext.refresh calls /auth/me only when a token or document.cookie is present — that's a solid fix, but on the public /login route users who previously logged out with a leftover taxquest_token in localStorage will still trigger a 401 on /auth/me. Consider clearing the token when /auth/me returns 401 (already done via setToken(null) in catch — good).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestBearerFallback class with 5 new tests; renamed docstring to TaxQuest; updated /api/ health assert to 'TaxQuest')

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested regression flows passed (rebrand text, localStorage token, cookies-cleared reload keeps session, chatbot streaming, register→persona banner, quiz feedback+next, explorer 48+search, save-smart India estimator, leaderboard rows, admin edit persistence)

test_credentials: Admin admin@taxmaster.pro / Admin@123 works. Fresh users via /register (qa+<ts>@test.com / TestPass1) work.
seed_data_creation: 48 countries + admin auto-seeded on startup. Test users created dynamically per test. Modified UAE notes during Admin edit test and restored them via direct API PUT after — no residual pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PRIMARY REGRESSION VERIFIED: Bearer fallback works end-to-end. localStorage key is 'taxquest_token'. Backend /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register return {..., 'access_token': '<jwt>'} in body. Frontend axios interceptor at /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js auto-attaches Authorization: Bearer header. Chatbot.jsx separately re-attaches Bearer for its fetch(). Admin edit modal fields: KEY/REGION/TYPE inputs, NOTES <textarea> (no testid — use 'textarea' selector), Save button has data-testid='admin-save'. Indian Quiz option testids are quiz-opt-0..3, next=quiz-next, feedback=quiz-feedback, qnum=quiz-qnum. Country cards use data-testid=country-card-<region> which can collide across a region (from iter_1) — noted low priority.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects found. The user-reported issue ('no feature is working') was addressed by the localStorage/Bearer fallback introduced in this iteration: even when 3rd-party cookies (SameSite=None; Secure) are blocked by the browser (Safari ITP, in-app webviews, corporate proxies) the app still authenticates every /api call using the Bearer token from localStorage. Confirmed by clearing all cookies via page.context.clear_cookies() and reloading — user stayed on /dashboard, /api/auth/me returned 200, chatbot successfully streamed a Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply.
